20  
  
GLIC016 Ozurdex® (dexamethasone implant- intravitreal) 
 
APPLICABLE AGENT(S): 
Ozurdex 
 
Criteria for Initial Approval Authorization: 
1. Coverage is provided in the following conditions: 
• Patient ≥18 years of age AND 
 
 Universal Criteria1  
• 
Patient is free of ocular and/or periocular infections (including active epithelial 
herpes simplex keratitis (dendritic keratitis), vaccinia, varicella, mycobacterial 
infections, and fungal diseases, etc.); AND  
• 
Patient does not have glaucoma with a cup to disk ratio of greater than 0.8; 
AND  
• 
Patient does not have a torn or ruptured posterior lens capsule; AND  
• 
Patient has not received a sustained-release corticosteroid in the same eye 
within the past 4 months; AND  
• 
Patient’s best corrected visual acuity (BCVA) is measured at baseline and 
periodically throughout treatment; AND  
• 
Patient’s intraocular pressure is measured at baseline and periodically 
throughout therapy; AND  
Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) †  
Macular Edema Following Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) or Central 
Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO) †  
Non-Infectious Uveitis Affecting the Posterior Segment of the Eye † Ф  
† FDA Approved Indication(s); ‡ Compendia Recommended Indication(s); Ф Orphan 
Drug 
CRITERIA FOR RENEWAL: 
Coverage may be renewed based upon the following criteria:  
• 
Patient continues to meet the universal and indication specific criteria as 
identified in section III; AND  
• 
Absence of unacceptable toxicity from the drug. Examples of unacceptable 
toxicity include: posterior subcapsular cataracts, increased intraocular pressure, 
endophthalmitis, eye inflammation, retinal detachments, etc.; AND  
Macular Edema Following BRVO or CRVO/Diabetic Macular Edema  
• 
Disease response as indicated by stabilization of visual acuity or improvement in 
best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) score when compared to baseline  
Non-Infectious Uveitis Affecting the Posterior Segment of the Eye  


=== PDF PAGE 21 ===
21  
  
• 
Disease response as indicated by: Stabilization of visual acuity or improvement 
in BCVA score when compared to baseline; OR  
• 
Improvement in vitreous haze score (decrease in inflammation)  
QUANTITY LIMITS 
Max frequency of administration is once every 4 months.  
Max Units: 14 billable units every 4 months (Max units are based on administration to 
both eyes) 
 
LENGTH OF AUTHORIZATION 
Initial Approval Duration: 6 months. Coverage will be provided for 1 implant per 
affected eye and may be renewed. Renewal Approval Duration: 1 year.
